mapper.insert: INSERT INTO custom_order_sheet (product_id, inquiry_id, sku_id, quantity, unit_price, options_text, status) VALUES (#{productId}, #{inquiryId}, #{skuId}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{optionsText}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT sheet_id AS sheetId, product_id AS productId, inquiry_id AS inquiryId, sku_id AS skuId, quantity, unit_price AS unitPrice, options_text AS optionsText, status FROM custom_order_sheet WHERE inquiry_id = #{inquiryId} ORDER BY sheet_id DESC LIMIT 1
